Title: Azure Maps Mobility Services is in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Maps Mobility Services, APIs for integrating real-time public transit network intelligence into enterprise applications, is now available in preview. Public transit is essential for analyzing, managing, and optimizing the flow of people through urban and rural areas alike, with applications in retail, field service, city management, and logistics. Azure Maps Mobility Services will be available for use in early June 2019. Azure Maps Spatial Operations Service is also now available to the public.

Learn more
